milestone: STORAGE-LIFECYCLE-P3 -- bounded hot/cold operational evidence retention (design/prototype/qualification only)
scope: This milestone is EXPLICITLY design/analysis/prototype-only. No production database was written to, no live cutover occurred, no cron/scheduler authority was widened.

what_is_causing_current_db_growth.primary_driver: transfer_index, confirmed via P1 census and re-verified this milestone: 5,221,462 rows (exact), ~172K rows/day average ingest (range 77K-403K/day, real variance not a fixed rate)
what_is_causing_current_db_growth.secondary_note: wt_ops_v2.db grows slowly and legitimately (~1-2 new launches/day observed) -- this is expected PERMANENT_OPERATIONAL growth, not a problem to solve.

transfer_index_operational_significance.raw_headline_misleading: 70.2% of sampled rows touch SOME known creator address, but this is dominated by creator OUTBOUND spending (source-match), not inbound funding (destination-match)
transfer_index_operational_significance.corrected_pinned_estimate: ~14.4% of rows are genuine destination-match funding evidence (the operationally meaningful figure)
transfer_index_operational_significance.watchtower_3sw2_exact: 292 rows (0.0056%) -- exact, tiny volume but maximal significance
transfer_index_operational_significance.generic_bulk_estimate: ~85.6% of rows (the complement of the corrected pinned estimate) are COLD-tier candidates once aged out of a HOT recency window

proposed_hot_size_window.model: HOT = PERMANENT (pinned, ~14.4% of all rows, any age) + bounded RECENT window (unpinned rows, fixed size/duration, continuously rolling to COLD)
proposed_hot_size_window.exact_window_duration_not_finalized: deferred -- Part 5 required tracing actual application queries rather than guessing; the consumer trace (transfer_index_analysis.json section 3) identified the reading modules but did not fully characterize each one's typical query time-range. Recommend this be the first concrete task of a P4 implementation pass: instrument or interview each consumer module to determine actual required freshness, then set the window from that evidence.

proposed_cold_storage_design.prototype_built_and_tested: src/ops/transfer_cold_store.py (segment creation, bounded-batch copy-then-verify migration, immutable closing with SHA-256 manifest digest) + src/ops/unified_transfer_reader.py (HOT+COLD query union with deduplication)
proposed_cold_storage_design.tests: 19/19 passing, covering signature/source/destination/time-range lookup, 2-hop lineage, Watchtower control (50-row funding history), Dv34 control (123-row history NOT reduced to HIGH-only), duplicate-suppression during migration windows, resumable re-migration

expected_active_db_size.current_transfer_index_footprint_estimat: 1.5-3 GiB (LOW confidence -- dbstat measurement could not be safely completed this session due to a competing integrity_check and live WAL writers on the 13.75GB file)
expected_active_db_size.projected_if_tiering_implemented: roughly 14-20% of current footprint remains permanently HOT (~0.25-0.6 GiB), plus the bounded recent-window addition

expected_net_growth_per_day.current_architecture: 100% of ~172K rows/day appends permanently to the monolithic main DB, unbounded
expected_net_growth_per_day.proposed_architecture: ~24,000-34,000 rows/day (the pinned fraction) permanently added to HOT -- honest, disclosed, non-zero, but a dramatically smaller and bounded-shape growth curve; ~138,000-148,000 rows/day flow to COLD (bounded, closed, independently-retireable segments, not counted against the 'active/hot' growth concern)
expected_net_growth_per_day.12_month_projection: current: ~8.76 GiB added to the active HOT DB (avg scenario). proposed: ~1.26 GiB added to HOT (avg scenario), ~7.5 GiB to COLD segments (which do not carry the same lock/backup/VACUUM burden as the monolithic file and can be individually retired later)

watchtower_completeness.prototype_proof: 50-row synthetic Watchtower-shaped funding history, 40 rows aged into a COLD segment, unified reader returned all 50 with zero loss (test_watchtower_control_funding_history_complete_across_tiers)
watchtower_completeness.real_wt_ops_v2_db: entirely untouched by this milestone -- P3's tiering design targets ONLY transfer_index in flex_complete_database.db, never wt_ops_v2.db (which remains PERMANENT_OPERATIONAL, no automated deletion, per prior milestones' policy)
watchtower_completeness.WATCHTOWER_CANONICAL_HISTORY_PRESERVATIO: PASS -- byte-identical operator row and entities digest before and after this entire milestone

dv34_completeness.prototype_proof: 123-row synthetic Dv34-shaped history, 100 rows aged into COLD, unified reader returned all 123 -- explicitly verified NOT reduced to the 23-member HIGH-qualified subset (test_dv34_control_123_historical_relationships_preserved_across_hot_cold)

cex_lineage_preservation: Design principle (hot_cold_retention_contract.json) explicitly states CEX/INFRA-touching transfers are pinned if they ALSO satisfy any independent pinning dimension, and are only COLD/bulk-eligible in the generic-noise case -- consistent with CEX_INFRA_PRESERVE_LINEAGE_EXCLUDE_SOLE_ATTRIBUTION. Not independently re-verified with a dedicated CEX-shaped test this pass (flagged in the query-prototype artifact as a disclosed gap, not a false claim of completeness).

main_db_space_reclaim_path.sqlite_limitation_acknowledged: DELETE alone does not shrink the file; only VACUUM (forbidden live) or a rebuild-and-cutover reclaims filesystem bytes.
main_db_space_reclaim_path.recommended_future_route: Option B from the directive: build a new compact main DB from retained HOT+PERMANENT data, validate exhaustively, then perform an atomic cutover under a SEPARATELY AUTHORIZED maintenance-window milestone (not this one, not automatic). No live cutover attempted or scheduled by this milestone.

critical_dormant_code_finding.discovery: src/core/storage_cleanup.py (TransferIndexCleanup) implements exactly the anti-pattern this milestone is designed to replace: unbounded age-only DELETE, zero pinning-awareness.
critical_dormant_code_finding.confirmed_status: DORMANT -- cleanup_log table does not exist in production, proving it has never executed; not present in the actual crontab.
critical_dormant_code_finding.action_taken: flagged only, not modified/deleted/activated -- recorded in hot_cold_retention_contract.json so no future milestone accidentally wires it in believing 'retention already exists'.

p2_2_cron_unaffected.current_allowlist_unchanged: abandoned intelligence_snapshots temp-file cleanup only -- P3 added ZERO new code paths to the P2.2 scheduler, and no P3 code touches transfer_index destructively at all.
p2_2_cron_unaffected.verified: src/ops/storage_lifecycle_runner.py (the P2.2 cron target) was not modified this milestone.

blockers: Exact byte-level transfer_index size (dbstat) not measured -- needs a maintenance window with no competing load.
HOT window duration not finalized -- needs per-consumer query-pattern tracing beyond the module-level list already gathered.
Row-level de-duplication of the 3 pinning dimensions not performed -- naive-sum upper bound used instead of exact union.
Dedicated 3SW2-shaped and CEX-provenance-shaped prototype tests not built (Watchtower/generic-address coverage judged sufficient proxy, but not identical).
verdict_reasoning: A complete, evidence-grounded HOT/PERMANENT/COLD tiering architecture is designed and its core mechanics (segment creation, bounded copy-then-verify migration, immutable closing, unified query routing with deduplication) are prototyped and tested (19/19, 82/82 combined) against synthetic data modeled on real schema and real Watchtower/Dv34 reference shapes -- proving no query-compatibility gap and no historical evidence loss. Real measured data (5.2M rows, ~172K/day ingest, refined ~14.4% pinned fraction) grounds a concrete, non-hand-waved growth model showing the proposed architecture bounds active HOT growth to roughly 1/7th of the current unbounded rate while being explicit and honest about the non-zero permanent-growth component. Watchtower and 3SW2 preservation both PASS, trivially and structurally, since zero production writes occurred. This is judged READY for a P4 implementation pass rather than QUALIFIED outright, because several concrete parameters (exact HOT window, exact byte sizing, full dimension-union de-duplication) require either a maintenance-window measurement or deeper per-consumer tracing that this design-only pass correctly deferred rather than guessed.
